map.[hota] gold rush.event.1.description: If you fail to take over the gold mines within two months, or, worse still, the mines will fall under control of other kingdoms, your head will roll. The royal executioner will gladly take it to amuse the impoverished peasants, even if it does not add a single coin to the treasury.
map.[hota] gold rush.event.2.description: A messenger has arrived from the capital. The situation in the heart of the Kingdom is getting worse by the day. If a way to fill the treasury is not found urgently, hunger riots and rebellions are inevitable, so every Monday you will have to send home a supply of treasure, no matter how much you need it to fulfil your mission.
map.[hota] gold rush.event.4.description: Scouts report that the rocky island is teeming with all sorts of warlocks and alchemists. Perhaps their secrets will help you solve your financial woes.
map.[hota] gold rush.event.5.description: The situation turned out to be even worse than expected; you will have to make do despite severe shortage of resources, as there are no developed mines in these lands. You'll have to rely on the scouts' cunning and their sticky fingers. Speaking of them, the scouts tell us that in place of the derilict sawmills and quarries, carts full of resources can be found. It would be nice to capture them.
map.[hota] gold rush.event.6.description: You're less than a week away from the deadline. Messengers arrive every day, handing over piles of angry demands - you recognize the King's trembling hand.
map.[hota] gold rush.event.7.description: According to reports, hunger riots broke out in the capital. The King sent you a visceral description of the executioner sharpening his axe, which made you shiver.
map.[hota] gold rush.event.8.description: This is the last day. Only a miracle or a perfectly calculated move can still save you and your kingdom.
map.[hota] gold rush.event.9.description: Half the time you've been given has passed. It would be nice to hurry up and take over these gold mines.
map.[hota] gold rush.header.description: The treasury is empty, and the mines exhausted... In these toilsome times the King sends you to the border of three countries, where on a rocky island, several yet untouched gold mines sit. Capture all four mines before the heroes of other kingdoms do so or the deadline comes, two months from now.
map.[hota] gold rush.header.name: Gold Rush
map.[hota] gold rush.header.rumor.0.text: Rumor has it that these acrid badlands became the new homeland for the Halflings who had fled Eeofol after the demons fell from the sky on burning stars.
map.[hota] gold rush.header.rumor.1.text: In the scorching sun of the prairies... A glimmering mountain stood up and walked at me! Then it became a volcano and let out black smoke, and on top of it, an eye opened.
map.[hota] gold rush.header.rumor.2.text: It's said that these dead, rocky wastelands are crawling with pyromancers and arsonists, and skilled smiths forge fire-spitting sticks for them.
map.[hota] gold rush.header.rumor.3.text: Ever met a gloomy man in a black cape with a big iron stick? Of course not, or you wouldn't be sitting here listening to this nonsense right now.
map.[hota] gold rush.header.rumor.4.text: I swear on all that's holy, when I was working as a prospector, I often felt something moving under my feet, deep under the ground!

map.[hota] headhunting.event.0.descripti: Not so long ago, you were enjoying a peaceful life in your manor, but it all changed after a risky venture. Now, following a series of unfortunate events, you have only one chance left to bring those days back. This chance lies in using a valuable artifact called the Sphere of Permanence to escape through a portal that leads to another continent. You had to steal this artifact from the imperial sorcerers. The bounty put on your head is exorbitant. Not only the imperial troops and mercenaries are yearning for it, but also the best enchanters and druids. You are within an inch of your life, as hordes of mercenaries have taken control of these lands and are preparing their assault. The portal that could save you is still far off, and precious few of your companions are still standing: some were killed, others captured. Trapped at the edge of the world, you decide to fight your chasers.
map.[hota] headhunting.event.3.descripti: Your scouts report that the mercenary bands can't agree on a truce, so they will hinder each other. Perhaps you can bribe some of them. Now you also have information about the status of all local shipyards.
map.[hota] headhunting.event.4.descripti: You've found a source of magical energy emanating from underground. This aura must mark the ritual site in the underground town of Eaglyre. Unfortunately, your enemies had found the portal first and sealed it with a multi-component key. To get the key, you'll need to "politely" ask them for its parts.

map.[hota] headhunting.header.descriptio: You are undoubtedly in trouble if, carrying a valuable artifact, you find yourself surrounded by mercenary bands, and even more so if you have but a handful of troops to protect you. However, there is always a chance.

map.[hota] heritage of the ancients.even: It took you a while to set up an outpost so far from your lands. Unfortunately, your actions did not go unnoticed. Soon, the ruler of a neighboring principality, your old enemy, arrived here too. This time, he hired an elementalist, who is equally eager to find out what secrets the tomb holds. However, you did not waste time either, enlisting the support of your old allies, the elves, who have long borne a grudge against your opponent.

It took you a while to set up an outpost so far from your lands. Unfortunately, your actions did not go unnoticed. Soon, the ruler of a neighboring principality, your old enemy, arrived here too. This time, he enlisted the support of the elves, who have long borne a grudge against you for cutting down their forests. It seems that this lord is equally eager to find out what secrets the tomb holds. But you did not waste time either, meeting an experienced elementalist on the way, who offered his services to you. They say these sorcerers are capable of summoning an entire army!

Knowledge, power... What does this tomb have in store? We do not know, but who other than wizards from the University of the Four Elements can possibly unravel its secrets? It has been a long time since we had a chance to study the legacy of such ancient times. 
However, rumor has it that we are not the only ones who have learned of the Tomb's existence. The greedy rulers of neighboring lands woud never miss an opportunity to get their hands on treasures and new magic knowledge. Their troops will probably appear here soon, so we sent gargoyle messengers to them.

It seems that you and your enemy are not the only ones who know about the Tomb. A gargoyle flew into our camp today. Of course, the creature was shot on the spot, but it carried a message in its paws. 
A wizard, who introduced himself as a representative of some University, reported that he and his “colleagues” knew about both the Tomb and your plans. He warned about the dangers allegedly lurking in the Tomb and hinted that you had no business being there. 
Without saying a word, you tear up the letter and return to your men to give new orders.

The gargoyles we sent with messages never returned, so we assume the worst; the rulers must have decided not only to settle their old scores, but also dared challenge us, ignoring our warning. So much the worse for them.
map.[hota] heritage of the ancients.head: An ancient tomb was found in faraway lands. Who knows what treasures and knowledge it holds? Alas, to your great dismay, your enemy has already learned about your plans to explore it…
Heritage of the Ancients
The Tomb is guarded by genies and efreet. Don’t mess with them!
Last time I was in the Tomb, I couldn't get out the same way I got in.
Don’t listen to what people say! It’s pretty easy to get out of the Tomb!
Once, travelling to the Tomb, I ran into a weird hovering eye. I barely escaped with my life!
They say that basilisks moved to the Tomb through the portals and settled there.
map.[hota] heritage of the ancients.ques: Do you want to conduct the ritual and create a portal to the Plane of Water?

There is a nexus of magic energy here; you could use it to create a portal to the Plane of Water and summon water elementals. However, you’ll have to pay 6000 gold for the ingredients needed for the ritual.
You can’t afford the ritual yet.

Great, here it is.
Do you want to buy the magic armor from the merchant?

I’m but a lowly merchant, but not so long ago I came by a thing of great magic power. The vagabond who brought it to me said he had found it in the Tomb and had barely escaped with it, being chased by some odd monsters. I don't know if this is true, but the item is of no use to me. I would be happy to offer it to you for mere 15 gems.
No, I wouldn’t sell this for less than 15 gems. In different conditions, it could command a much higher price.
Do you want to hire the Pixies?
You can hire Pixies here, but they demand 3500 gold.
The Pixies are not ready to join your ranks for less than 3500 gold.
Do you want to hire the Magi?
Magi mercenaries take stand here. To hire them for your army, you’ll have to pay them 5000 gold.
The Magi are not ready to join your ranks for less than 5000 gold.

Never thought I would have to study mummies like a filthy necromancer! Well, lore carries a price. I haven’t forgotten about your reward; take it.
Do you want to take the magic scroll from a druid?

I arrived here as a representative of the Circle of Druids. I want to study the creatures who settled down in the Tomb; who knows how a habitat like this influenced them? Bring me enough creatures so I could do research, and I will give you a magic scroll that would allow you to travel over water as easily as over land.
No, I need more creatures for my research. Return when you have enough of them.
Do you want to hire the Elves and get the anti-magic armor?
Elf mercenaries take stand here. To hire them for your host, you’ll have to pay them 5000 gold. They also have a decent armor enchanted to repel magic.
The Elves are not ready to join your ranks for less than 5000 gold.

map.[hota] ice assault.event.2.descripti:
In recent years, it's been getting colder and colder, and grazing grounds are becoming increasingly scarce. The elders are gathering to discuss an attack on our enemies' lands.
However, rumors have reached us: portals have opened near our villages. Apparently, our enemies have learned of our plans and are preparing to attack us. We must prepare for any eventuality.
map.[hota] ice assault.event.3.descripti: It is said that the lizardmen and gnolls of the eastern islands have entered into the service of demons. It is difficult to say what prompted these creatures to take such a step, but it is known that a volcano has awakened on the northeastern islands. Hordes of Gogs surrounded by Cerberi and other creatures have been seen near it.
map.[hota] ice assault.event.4.descripti: A kobold, sent to explore one of the distant portals, brought odd news. The elven sorceress who rules the northern islands has opened portals to a distant, uncharted land she calls the "world of chaos." We don't know what might await us on the other side of these portals, but it seems the elves themselves are showing great interest in them.
map.[hota] ice assault.event.5.descripti: The yeti report disturbing news. They managed to penetrate the "world of chaos" following the elf who opened a portal there. It turns out the portal leads to lands ruled by the forces of cold and death. They are gathering troops to invade our lands, and they are led by a dark sorceress who has subjugated the will of the elves. Her forces are vast, and their ranks include not only the undead, but even titans and powerful blue dragons. And it seems she is behind the quarrels among all the neighbors.
map.[hota] ice assault.header.descriptio: For centuries, the inhabitants of the icy land have stayed within their lands, fighting off raids from their neighbors drawn by the crystals and other riches. In recent months, however, the weather has grown colder, and now our enemies' realms are suffering from frost. It's time to strike back.

map.[hota] ice assault.quest.101.88.0.co: Would you like to give the witch gold and resources in exchange for the gorgons?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.101.88.0.fi: The witch tells you that after everything she's been through lately, she no longer cares about power. However, she wants to save enough money to retire and live a comfortable life. She believes 20,000 gold, 30 measures of sulfur, and the same amount of mercury will be enough. In exchange, she will give you her last herd of gorgons.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.101.88.0.ne: The witch does not agree to a smaller amount, and you do not have the necessary funds at the moment.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.102.103.1.c: The shaman begins a strange ritual, but it fails: both he and the birds vanish in a burst of flame. Well, at least the tame blue dragon is still here. Would you like to take it with you?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.102.103.1.f: The old shaman says he wants to create an endless source of heat, but to do so, he needs five live firebirds. In exchange, he'll give you a blue dragon he managed to tame.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.102.103.1.n: Without birds, a shaman cannot create a source of fire.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.104.97.0.co: The farm guards have scattered. Do you want to go through?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.104.97.0.fi: Here, Thias breeds gorgons. To take possession of the farm, its current owner must be eliminated. They say he keeps some kind of magical trinket there.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.104.97.0.ne: As long as Thias is alive, the farm belongs to him.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.105.6.0.com: Viveca is defeated, and the barrier is now easily removed. Do you wish to proceed?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.105.6.0.fir: The passage is closed by a magical barrier, maintained by an elven sorceress, protecting her current mistress.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.105.6.0.nex: First defeat the elven sorceress, then you can pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.11.94.0.com: The guards have scattered, and the gates are now open. Do you want to go through?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.11.94.0.fir: This road leads to a portal that the local knights call "the gates of heaven" and guard like nothing else. As long as the head of their order, Rhiannon, lives, it will be impossible to pass through.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.11.94.0.nex: Rhiannon is alive, and the guards at the gates will not let you pass, and you will not be able to take it by storm.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.14.32.0.com: The barbarian is ready to gift you his club. Would you like to take it?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.14.32.0.fir: An old barbarian lives in this house. He's willing to gift his favorite club to anyone who can demonstrate sufficient attack skill.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.14.32.0.nex: Your skills are not yet sufficient, come back later.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.2.92.0.comp: Do you want to learn a powerful resurrection spell?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.2.92.0.firs: Priests who know the secret of resurrecting the dead live here. They are willing to share it with you, but in exchange, they require you to bring them the Cornucopia, so that they may have everything they need for the rest of their days. They are also willing to give you one of three keys needed to enter the magical library in the northern caves. The components of the Cornucopia can be found in the treasuries of the blue dragons: two on the islands to the north, one in the sea to the south, and one somewhere in the caves.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.24.52.0.com: You insert the amulet into a special slot, and the door opens. The elves are ready to join you. Would you like to accept them into your army?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.24.52.0.fir: Elves languish here, trapped by demons for refusing to fight by their side. They will gladly follow you if you find the key to their prison, in the form of a strange skull amulet. It is said the demons buried it somewhere in the east of these lands.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.24.52.0.nex: Without the key the elves cannot be freed.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.25.96.0.com: Angels are ready to follow you. Do you want to hire them?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.25.96.0.fir: The angels here have already sworn allegiance to the northern elves, but for the right reward, they're willing to follow you. For their services, they ask for 75 gems and 50,000 gold.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.25.96.0.nex: You don't have the required amount, and the angels won't settle for less.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.27.83.0.fir: This passage leads to the lands of the knights. But first, the barbarian leader, Nell, must be defeated. It would be unwise to leave such a dangerous enemy behind.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.27.83.0.nex: Nell is still alive, and her army is still strong and threatening your rear area.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.35.42.0.com: Do you want to rebuild elf houses?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.35.42.0.fir: The elven houses have been damaged by fire and the elves are asking you to rebuild their homes. Then they will serve you. You need 40 measures of wood and 25,000 gold.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.35.42.0.nex: More resources are needed to rebuild elven houses.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.36.67.0.fir: The gates here open with a password known only to representatives of the land of ice. Here, the local elders explain how to open the magical barriers with which they have sealed all key points in this area to protect their people from enemy attacks.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.36.67.0.nex: The gates here open with a password known only to representatives of the land of ice. Here, the local elders explain how to open the magical barriers with which they have sealed all key points in this area to protect their people from enemy attacks.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.37.73.0.com: Do you want to get gold?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.37.73.0.fir: Our elders are willing to pay for the heads of the commanders leading the enemy armies that invade our lands. Bring evidence of the death of Atreia, and you will receive the money.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.37.73.0.nex: The enemy commander is still alive. Kill him and return for your reward.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.4.52.0.comp: Sveva is dead, and the jotunns are ready to join your forces. Do you wish to accept them?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.4.52.0.firs: These jotunns are forced to pay tribute to the witch Sveva, who has settled on an island further south. If you defeat her, they are ready to join you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.4.52.0.next: Sveva is still strong, the jotunns cannot join you.

map.[hota] ice assault.quest.40.50.0.com: The competition organizers are pleased and ready to hand you the arrows. Would you like to take them?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.40.50.0.fir: An archery competition is being held here. But representatives of the northern elves, underground dwellers, and lizardmen from the eastern lands have not shown up. Find those who agree to participate, and the organizers are willing to give you magic arrows as a reward.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.40.50.0.nex: More participants are needed for the competition to start.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.42.2.1.comp: The librarians look at you, then at the artifacts you've brought, and finally nod. Would you like to enter the library?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.42.2.1.firs: The librarians in blue robes look at you sternly. They say that only those who take all the signs from their brothers on the surface will be allowed into the library.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.42.2.1.next: Librarians won't let you in without the right signs.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.43.48.0.com: Do you want to build mammoth stalls?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.43.48.0.fir: Wild mammoths roam here. You can tame them and build stalls for them, but this will cost 15,000 gold and 40 units of ore.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.43.48.0.nex: These funds are not enough to build mammoth stalls.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.45.95.0.fir: This passage leads to the lands of the knights. But first, the barbarian leader, Nell, must be defeated. It would be unwise to leave such a dangerous enemy behind.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.45.95.0.nex: Nell is still alive, and her army is still strong and threatening your rear area.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.39.0.com: Neia easily beats the sharpshooters. They are amazed by her skill and ready to join her. Do you want to welcome sharpshooters to your army?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.39.0.fir: The local sharpshooters are eager to embark on adventures with a worthy hero. But they'll only consider someone as worthy as they are at shooting.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.39.0.nex: You're losing the competition with sharpshooters. Apparently, someone more skilled is needed.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.50.0.com: Are you ready to perform the ritual?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.50.0.fir: This mage has learned to draw power from ice creatures. He agrees to perform a ritual and share some of the resulting power with you if you bring enough of such creatures.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.50.0.nex: Until you have brought enough creatures, the ritual cannot be performed.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.5.36.0.comp: The cyclopes are ready to follow you. Do you want to hire them?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.5.36.0.firs: The local cyclopes want more money and crystals for their services, which for some reason they value highly. 20 crystals and 10,000 gold are enough to hire them.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.5.36.0.next: You don't have the required amount, and the cyclopes won't agree to less.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.6.44.0.comp: The jotunn emerges from his hut and waves his hand in greeting, inviting you into his abode. Would you like to follow him?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.6.44.0.firs: A hermit jotunn lives here. He wants to see one of his brothers from the island to the south. Until he hears from them, he won't communicate with you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.6.44.0.next: The jotunn looks at you and goes back into the hut.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.68.7.0.comp: Ossian is dead, and the barrier can now be easily removed. Do you wish to proceed further?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.68.7.0.firs: The passage is blocked by a magical barrier brimming with necrotic energy. This is clearly Ossian's doing.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.68.7.0.next: As long as Ossian is alive, it is useless to try to pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.69.84.0.com: Would you like these Shamans to join you?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.69.84.0.fir: These Shamans are terrified by what's been happening in the world lately. They trust only their own kind and won't join anyone else. They say they possess some kind of a magical artifact.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.69.84.0.nex: Until one of them is with you, the Shamans don't even want to listen to you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.72.103.0.co: You insert the key you took from Nell into the lock and the gate opens. Would you like to pass?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.72.103.0.fi: This passage leads to the Silver Caves. The key to it has recently been kept by Nell, and now the neighbor clearly won't give it up to you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.72.103.0.ne: This passage leads to the Silver Caves. The key to it has recently been kept by Nell, and now the neighbor clearly won't give it up to you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.74.8.0.firs: Austain the Elementalist have created the water barrier blocking any passage in these waters. Until he is defeated, the barrier will stand.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.74.8.0.next: Austain the Elementalist have created the water barrier blocking any passage in these waters. Until he is defeated, the barrier will stand.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.75.47.0.com: Do you wish to give the Pendant of Reflection to the sorcerer?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.75.47.0.fir: The local sorcerer is willing to teach you how to blind your opponents in battle. In exchange, he wants the Pendant of Reflection worn by Porphyrios.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.75.47.0.nex: The sorcerer only needs the Pendant, he will not agree to anything else.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.76.106.0.co: Now the mage can found his own order, and he offers you a magic book. Will you take it?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.76.106.0.fi: You enter the home of a hermit mage who has lived in these parts for a long time. He says he wants to found an order of magical mastery, and to do so, he needs fifty worthy apprentices. In exchange, he's willing to give you a powerful magical book. They say the best mages live in the north, in the lands of the elves who study elemental magic.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.76.106.0.ne: You haven't yet gathered the required number of apprentices, and without them it's better not to bother the mage.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.78.27.1.com: Do you want to attract angels to your service?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.78.27.1.fir: Angels live here and are willing to serve you for a reasonable fee. 50,000 gold and 50 gems will do.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.78.27.1.nex: Angels will not settle for less than 50,000 gold and 50 gems.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.80.34.0.com: Do you wish to get the magical helm?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.80.34.0.fir: A powerful retired water mage lives here. He wants you to bring him several valuable composite artifacts for study—the components of these relics are scattered throughout these lands, and traveling on his own is becoming too difficult for him. In exchange, he promises to give you his magical helm — the mage can hardly use it for anything except brewing tea now, anyway.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.9.44.0.comp: The jotunn is ready to begin his tale right now. Would you like to hear his instructions?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.9.44.0.firs: The jotunn explains to you that he needs eight pendants he once acquired during glorious campaigns, but then sold them to various people, and he doesn't know where they are now. If you bring them, he's ready to share his wisdom with you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.9.44.0.next: The jotunn looks at you, not saying a word. He clearly has no intention of speaking to you until you bring him the pendants.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.11.1.com: The devils are opening the passage to their home. Do you want to go through?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.11.1.fir: The local devils avoid Harro like the plague. As long as he's alive, they won't accept your command.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.11.1.nex: Harro is still alive, and the devils don't want to come into your service.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.94.1.com: Harro is vanquished, and you can pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.94.1.fir: Harro the Efreeti have created the barrier, blocking the passage here. You need to defeat him if you want to pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.94.1.nex: Harro the Efreeti have created the barrier, blocking the passage here. You need to defeat him if you want to pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.92.107.0.co: You insert the intricate key into a keyhole on one of the columns, and the portal glows with a soft light. Do you wish to enter?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.92.107.0.fi: One of the captured lizardmen said he saw the demon lord Harro give the key to this portal to the lizardman chieftain Thias. He most likely still has it.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.92.107.0.ne: Without defeating Thias, the key to the mysterious portal cannot be obtained.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.96.24.1.com: The demons greedily snatch up the gems and scatter. Do you want to pass?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.96.24.1.fir: The demon guards here can be bribed for 50 gems.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.96.24.1.nex: The demons will not agree to less than 50 gems.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.97.28.1.com: The demons greedily snatch up the gems and scatter. Do you want to pass?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.97.28.1.fir: The demon guards here can be bribed for 50 gems.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.97.28.1.nex: The demons will not agree to less than 50 gems.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.3.0.comp: Viveca is defeated, and the barrier is now easily removed. Do you wish to proceed?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.3.0.firs: The passage is closed by a magical barrier, maintained by an elven sorceress, protecting her current mistress.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.3.0.next: First defeat the elven sorceress, then you can pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.88.0.com: —  Finally this bastard is dead! — says the witch with obvious satisfaction. — Now, if you want, we can talk.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.88.0.fir: A witch who ruled over the lizardmen and gnolls before the demon-worshipper Thias rose to power, lives here. She knows Thias is desperate to kill her, so she won't let anyone past the magical barrier in front of her dwelling as long as he's alive.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.88.0.nex: — Bring me Thias's head, then we'll talk! —  the witch shouts from her dwelling..

Southwest: Lizardmen and Gnolls
Southwest: Lizardmen and Gnolls
map.[hota] ice assault.sign.57.77.0.mess: Beware if you're not a local.
map.[hota] in defense.event.1.descriptio: A group of fishermen have come from Galantier. They ran like hell itself was on their heels to deliver troubling news: they spied a group of pirates burning fires on a nearby island. This is bad. Looks like the scoundrels are planning to attack us. The biggest problem is, Erathian army's on a march far away, having spared only a couple of guards to protect us. Tough luck for anyone who settled down here. Anyway, we cannot possibly run and the army will take too long to get here. So it seems we've no other option than to stand our ground against the uninvited guests.
map.[hota] in defense.event.2.descriptio: We must take control over Fort Bullden. It won't take much material to rebuild it, but, according to locals, it's currently occupied by a band of brigands. We should deal with those and start preparing to face the pirates there, although it would be even better to attack first.
map.[hota] in defense.event.3.descriptio: The remaining settlements, namely Dulvein and Galantier, are still not aware of the pirate presence. We should get there, gather the militia and prepare for the worst. It would be very useful to erect walls and battlements there, but we'll need scores of wood and ore for that. We have to act, and quickly!
map.[hota] in defense.guards.17.37.0.mes: A horde of creatures with fish-like tails and icy skin are gathered around some sort of an orb. If you wish you may fight them for it.
map.[hota] in defense.guards.32.39.1.mes: You observe a small vault, looking like an open temple with the legendary Golden Bow floating inside it. It is however guarded by Dread Knights. Do you wish to fight for that magnificent artifact?
map.[hota] in defense.header.description: Local villages have caught wind of a menace coming from the sea. Pirates are on their way to pillage these lands. The Erathian army is far away, and the villagers are on their own here…
map.[hota] in defense.header.name: In Defence
map.[hota] in defense.quest.12.58.0.comp: Oh, I've almost lost hope of ever seeing my treasure again! As we agreed, 25 of my students are ready to come under your banner. I assure you, they'll prove to be much more useful than this ring.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.12.58.0.firs: I have heard about your trouble. It turns out I've got some as well. My Ring of Infinite Gems was stolen by thieves and sold for quite a price to the titans on the shore. I understand that you have the pirate menace on your hands, but I can offer you a decent price for the ring. I train enchanters here, and 25 of my students would be eager to come to your aid.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.12.58.0.next: A deal is a deal. No Ring of Infinite Gems means no army of Enchanters for you.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.45.39.1.comp: Oh my! You really went and granted my request! I cannot express my joy with words! Now my experiment may continue without a hitch. I won't even regret parting with a relic for that. This sword has been collecting dust inside my chest for too long already. It is yours.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.45.39.1.firs: Greetings, stranger! Do you suppose you could help me? I'm conducting a very important experiment, but a small nuance escaped me: I need 60 sulphur to complete it, and I currently have none. I'll lose all progress I made if I don't get it, and soon! Could you provide me with the material? I assure you, it will not go unrewarded. I don't have enough money to pay for that, but I've got an item that might be of some use for you.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.57.42.0.comp: I can't believe you did it! Although I don't have to since you brought the heads of these beasts. Well, a deal's a deal, i guess? Make yourself comfortable, and I'll tell you all you need to know.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.57.42.0.firs: A pack of Green Dragons have settled nearby. They are a great danger to everyone, not only a knight travelling on his own. I can't really pay you anything, but I can share my experience. It should come in handy in your war with pirates.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.57.42.0.next: The Green Dragons are still there.

map.[hota] invasion.event.1.description:
The North is harsh and inhospitable. Anyone who has ever dared to set foot on our lands knows this.

For many years, hardly anyone so much as dared to set foot on our frozen soil. Only occasionally, the rulers of neighboring lands, irked with the attacks of yeti and frost giants on their pastures, would launch punitive expeditions here, but those were short-lived; they understood they would be unable to consolidate their hold, let alone capture all of the northern wastelands.

But recently, a messenger from a southern village on the other side of the Rannock river brought alarming news: a huge army of the undead had attacked one of the northern kingdoms, quickly subjugating it.

Before we could do anything, a southern village fell to the undead, and soon they crossed the river and captured another one to the east.

This must stop. If the undead manage to gain a foothold on this shore, dislodging them may prove impossible. We must retake the village and strike back.
map.[hota] invasion.event.2.description: A frost giant who returned from the south says he saw burning boats filled with undead, set ablaze by the elves' arrows. Interesting. It seems as though we're not the only ones fighting these creatures.
map.[hota] invasion.event.3.description: A messenger representing the elves of the southern lands arrived in our village. He reported a large camp of elven archers located in the south, which had been successfully repelling attacks by the undead for some time.
map.[hota] invasion.header.description: For many years, no one dared to invade the northern lands, inhabited only by snow elves and other tribes, and of little value. But the necromancers weren't interested in gold or gems...
map.[hota] invasion.header.name: Invasion
map.[hota] invasion.heroes.64.name: Nepenthes
map.[hota] invasion.quest.1.62.0.complet: Excellent. Are you ready to begin crafting the artifact?
map.[hota] invasion.quest.1.62.0.firstVi: You've met an elven craftsman who makes custom artifacts. He's willing to craft a Golden Bow for 20,000 gold, but it will take some time.
map.[hota] invasion.quest.1.62.0.nextVis: That's not enough! I need 20,000 gold, no less!
map.[hota] invasion.quest.28.47.0.comple: Upon learning of your victory, the jotunn readily announces that he will train your own jotunns for free.
map.[hota] invasion.quest.28.47.0.firstV: The jotunn living on this island complains about his sworn enemies, the minotaurs, who have captured a neighboring island and keep pestering him with uninvited visits. The giant declares he is willing to help you train your own jotunns if you take care of these horned beasts.
map.[hota] invasion.quest.28.47.0.nextVi: The jotunn claims he still hears the roars of minotaurs at night and refuses to help you.
map.[hota] island of dust.event.0.descri: This is the legendary Island of Dust, home for many generations of dragons. You're standing on the shore admiring the newly built fort, which will serve as the base for your glorious deeds.
map.[hota] island of dust.event.1.descri: They'll have to be quite glorious indeed. To breach the dragons' lair, to claim the treasure of five continents all for yourself, and to seethe your blade in the boiling blood! There is a problem, though: your crew spotted three other sheeps sailing towards the isle. Whoever arrived on those, must be planning on doing the same.
map.[hota] island of dust.event.2.descri: Was it a bad idea to rush into the desert right away after disembarking? The coast is still covered in thick growth, despite the burnt middle. These strips of tropical forest are inhabited by scary beasts. It might sound weird, but the beasts seem willing to help you overthrow the dragons.
map.[hota] island of dust.event.3.descri:
The scouts have returned from the Desert. Not all of them. Actually, those who did, barely did it, and they won't be able to go back anytime soon. It would be one thing if they came back covered in burns and torn up by dragon claws... but they brought back worse news! The desert is thick already with spies sent by the three lords whose ships you spied earlier.  
The dragons seem to have lost their grip, and new fortifications have risen above the sands. Looks like the bounty hunters are going to be hunting each other...
map.[hota] island of dust.header.descrip: This tropical isle has been lying in ashes for ages, since its dragon inhabitants scorched the lush land around the crater in the middle. Several adventurers arrived to the once beautiful land. They will have to be fearless and valiant if they want to claim the treasure of the blistering sands.
map.[hota] island of dust.header.name: Island of Dust
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.104.65.0: Finally, some subjects for my experiments! I swear now, by the time there's one last Satyr left I'll iron every error out, and then I'll make as many as I promised!

I'm trying to master the Clone spell, but I don't have enough volunteers I can test it on. Would you be so kind to bring me, say, 24 of the Satyrs whose dwelling is to the North, I'd happily double that number!
Yesterday I experimented with a pig that happened to pass by. It now has two heads anf five legs! Obviously, I'll do much better after you bring me 24 Satyrs!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.28.9.0.c: Finally, some subjects for my experiments! I swear now, by the time there's one last Boar left I'll iron every error out, and then I'll make as many as I promised!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.28.9.0.f: I'm trying to master the Clone spell, but I don't have enough volunteers I can test it on. Would you be so kind to bring me, say, 48 of the Boar Riders whose dwelling is to the North, I'd happily double that number!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.28.9.0.n: Yesterday I tried to clone some pebbles I found on the beach... let's say it wasn't a successful experiment. Obviously, I'll do much better after you bring me 48 Boar Riders!
Finally, some subjects for my experiments! I swear now, by the time there's one last Rogue left I'll iron every error out, and then I'll make as many as I promised!

I'm trying to master the Clone spell, but I don't have enough volunteers I can test it on. Would you be so kind to bring me, say, 48 of the Rogues whose dwelling is to the West, I'd happily double that number!

I took a boat yesterday and went to try my spell on that mermaid there. The result... well, I still can't quite double a living creature, but I think sailors will be happy with what I've accomplished this time. Obviously, I'll do much better after you bring me 48 rogues!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.8.87.0.c: Finally, some subjects for my experiments! I swear now, by the time there's one last Troll left I'll iron every error out, and then I'll make as many as I promised!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.8.87.0.f: I'm trying to master the Clone spell, but I don't have enough volunteers I can test it on. Would you be so kind to bring me, say, 18 of the Trolls whose dwelling is to the North, I'd happily double that number!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.8.87.0.n: Yesterday I was passing by a mill and I decided to experiment with the miller's cockerel. I now have enough chicken heads to make soup for the next month! Obviously, I'll do much better after you bring me 18 trolls!
map.[hota] island of dust.sign.26.82.0.m: Not so fast, o traveler! It may be your last drink before you head into the Waste.
map.[hota] island of dust.sign.34.28.0.m: Not so fast, o traveler! It may be your last drink before you head into the Waste.

map.[hota] just win, or else.event.0.des: Onwards, to battle! There is nothing to wait for: everything is here for your victory! Just come and take it by force... or else.
map.[hota] just win, or else.header.desc: All the fortresses have already been built up, all the mercenaries lured in with coin, and legendary treasures found. All that remains to do is rear up powerful heroes who will seize the opportunity and defeat the adversary, just as well-prepared though.
map.[hota] just win, or else.header.name: Just Win, Or Else
map.[hota] key to victory - the second k: Your enemy runs! Your enemy is terrified! Amid this chaos, your court's loyal sages managed to erect barriers along the entire contact line, encircling the remnants of the enemy host. Nowhere to run, nowhere to hide.
Muster a powerful army and decide for yourself when to pass through the barriers for the final battle. Stand to horse!

Your scouts report: some crucial mines with valuable resources are still held by the enemy. The scoundrel used summoning magic; the mines are now guarded by elementals. Still, you are going to need resources, and you can scarce allow the enemy's heroes, even summoned ones, to nose around your rear! While the risk of sabotage has been mitigated by the newly erected barriers, to defeat the elemental heroes remains your task to tackle.

Your sentries have brought unexpected news. Anticipating his imminent downfall, your enemy has built his own barriers; only his own troops can pass through them. It seems as though you are now to find a new key to victory.
Under the withered roots of a dead tree, you find the Sandals of the Saint.
All the stolen wealth lies behind the magic portal. Even after losing several battles in a row, your enemy is still eager to fight for this treasure.

In the backyard of an Alchemist's Lab, you notice the Armor of Wonder. After a brief chat with the lab's bewildered owner, puzzled as to how the enchanted breastplate wound up on his property, you take it.

Barriers protect these parts from the enemy. His troops will not be able to set foot on this sacred land! If you want to venture beyond the barriers yourself, however, you will have to find the Light Blue Keymaster's Tent first.
The Oracle is ready to show you some interesting places nearby. He bows and waves you into the hut.

You're strolling along the forest's edge, pretending to hunt for mushrooms, but the leprechaun seems to have caught on to your presence. He narrows his eyes, and his dance becomes slower: he is prepared to pounce at you at any moment. As luck would have it, the telltale glint reveals the location of the leprechaun's treasure. Before the green prankster can reach you, you snatch a Celestial Necklace of Bliss out of a small stash.

The tall grass around the old cart hints at its long disuse. You carefully examine the cart: it misses one wheel, and a metal object props up its front axle. It is not without effort that you extract it: to your infinite surprise, it turns out to be the Lion's Shield of Courage.
You feel around the bottom of a fetid puddle and find a hilt. Grabbing it, you pull out the Sword of Judgement, untouched by either rust or reeking scum.
There's an ambush ahead! Luckily, your scouts noticed the Sharpshooters hiding in the trees. There aren't too many of them, but forewarned means armed!

Your eye catches the faint swaying of the air, distorting the outlines of grass blades on the ground. As you get closer, you realize that there is an invisible casket in front of you. With some sweat, you manage to unravel the casket's secret and find the Helm of Heavenly Enlightenment inside.

Back in the day, mercenaries from all over the world would flock to these lands to join the mighty Legion's hosts. Even after his death, the monument to him kept stirring admiration in the hearts of both young soldiers and seasoned veterans. Today, however, only the base and legs of the great monument remain. Could you can find a way to restore the Statue of Legion?

The decisive battle had just died down. A fleeing enemy is trapped in the mountains, with slim chances to mount a counterattack. Your position is nigh invulnerable: you only need to go and put an end to this long war.
Key to Victory: The Second Key
It is said that the Angelic Alliance was destroyed during the war. Some also claim that the great artifact can yet be recreated if its lost parts are found.
In the backyard of an Alchemist's Lab...
Under a tall dead tree...
At the bottom of a pit flooded with the waters of the great lakes...
The leprechaun keeps a keen eye on his real treasure...
Under a cart at an old sawmill...
Unseen, it rests among the flowers planted by the students at the magic school...
Beyond these gates lie lands where no one can guarantee your safety. However, as long as you are on this side, you have nothing to fear.
Remember: by commanding your Border Guards to stand down, you will open the way not only for yourself, but also for your enemies!

Unlock the gates at your own risk! Once opened, they will no longer protect you from the enemy.

map.[hota] king of the hill.event.0.desc: You are trembling. Either from anger, or from the actual earthquake. Those seven scoundrels, those bastards! They will pay! Your revenge will be like a firestorm. With these thoughts you ordered the standard-bearer to raise the flag of your color. The march has begun! Scarlet glow is seen far away on top of the mountain.
map.[hota] king of the hill.event.1.desc: The glow has densed on the horizon. Furthermore, the air has been filled with smallest ash particles. The mighty volcano is erupting. The castles of your enemies are standing at its side. The legend tells that deep inside there is a Heart city. The one controlling that city will be able to control the volcano's power. You grinned with your yellowed teeth and spurred your horse.
map.[hota] king of the hill.header.descr: The hatred of eight lords, like volcano, is about to erupt towards each other in a bloody war. It will get hot soon!
map.[hota] king of the hill.header.name: King of the Hill
map.[hota] king of the hill.header.rumor: No matter who will win. The volcano will erupt any moment and the flow of molten lava will destroy both the winners and the losers.
map.[hota] long road.event.0.description: You fell to thinking. How could it be that the enemy’s spies were discovered deep beyond the line of defense? They surely could not slip by your fortified garrisons, as through all the centuries your kingdom has existed, the only road binding all the towns, like beads on a thread, have existed.
map.[hota] long road.event.1.description: You heard that these lands had been regions of an ancient country long ago, and its inhabitants mastered a secret of moving to very long distances. However, this knowledge had been lost many years ago, and even your best sorcerers were unable to discover the mystery of such travels. Maybe little pieces of such knowledge are still preserved somewhere at the countryside ruined by war, but unfortunately it is definitely not in your capital.
map.[hota] long road.guards.1.28.1.messa: A poor footworn path ended when you entered into a swampy grove. But even here there is a kind of a road: a brook swirls and snaggles in the brushing and thick bog, thus making a hard but safe way for strangers.
map.[hota] long road.guards.14.1.1.messa: Beyond this garrison begin the disputed lands, battles for which are particularly cruel. There is no opportunity to maintain the road in a due state here, and rubble which somewhere replaced the paved stone of the capital, is replaced with a well-footworn ground.
map.[hota] long road.guards.18.1.0.messa: Beyond this garrison begin the disputed lands, battles for which are particularly cruel. There is no opportunity to maintain the road in a due state here, and rubble which somewhere replaced the paved stone of the capital, is replaced with a well-footworn ground.
map.[hota] long road.guards.3.33.0.messa: A mystical obelisk built here long before the first state ever appeared, divides the road in two. We could leave our quarrels behind, and each state would possess its own side of the road. But how can you stay only halfway?
map.[hota] long road.guards.3.34.1.messa: It seems you found the root of all evil. The ruins behind the monsters shine with a magic light. Can it be that forgotten roads and crossroads are alive again, and your enemy already uses it all in full?
map.[hota] long road.guards.32.33.1.mess: A mystical obelisk built here long before the first state ever appeared, divides the road in two. We could leave our quarrels behind, and each state would possess its own side of the road. But how can you stay only halfway?
map.[hota] long road.guards.34.18.0.mess: A poor footworn path ended when you entered into a swampy grove. But even here there is a kind of a road: a brook swirls and snaggles in the brushing and thick bog, thus making a hard but safe way for strangers.
map.[hota] long road.guards.34.34.0.mess: It seems you found the root of all evil. The ruins behind the monsters shine with a magic light. Can it be that forgotten roads and crossroads are alive again, and your enemy already uses it all in full?
map.[hota] long road.header.description: The struggle of two sovereigns have reminded a tug of war for decades. It is no surprise: the only road bounds the capitals of two kingdoms, and villages are doomed to change hands. But recently the spies of your enemy were discovered deep beyond the defense line. Could a back-way appear somewhere?
map.[hota] long road.header.name: Long Road
map.[hota] long road.sign.16.22.0.messag: This way shall only open to those who mastered the ancient secrets of light and darkness.
map.[hota] long road.sign.19.19.1.messag: This way shall only open to those who mastered the ancient secrets of light and darkness.
map.[hota] maelstrom.header.description: No one can predict which side the wheel of fortune turns. Try your luck, warrior, in the lands that may want you to abandon your home forever. Advance in the lands where nothing is permanent!
map.[hota] maelstrom.header.name: Maelstrom
map.[hota] marsh.event.0.description: The people of these godforsaken lands live in constant fear. Anyone daring to turn from the broad road in the thicket, does not come back... every day a few people disappear in the swamp. Someone said that this is an evil spirit’s deed. Others accuse forest animals, but no one knows the truth.
map.[hota] marsh.event.1.description: It is time to change this situation once and for all! To succeed, resolve the conflict with the other three lords that rule over these marshes. The diplomatic negotiation resulted in a stalemate. Not a single diplomat returned from the mission. Also, not a single representative of other lords has visited you. They might have perished at hands of foul spirit in the swamp... Or maybe enemy armies are marching towards you already, ready for a sneak attack! In that case, we have to forestall them!
map.[hota] marsh.header.description: The roads are clean and safe, but the one who dares to turn into a dark thicket, will gain wealth and power.
map.[hota] marsh.header.name: Marsh
map.[hota] mysterious ways.header.descri: This small realm lives by its own rules. Everything here is subject to change in a snap of fingers. New paths appear in the woods, waiting for an adventurer to set foot upon them. You will have to blaze your own way to triumph.
map.[hota] mysterious ways.header.name: Mysterious Ways
You weren't thinking you'd just come here and take this blade, were you?
map.[hota] paradise lost.header.descript: Once upon a time, there was a magical city in this beautiful valley. However, a terrible cataclysm made it disappear under the water. After the disaster, many people tried to locate it and understand what caused the calamity, but their efforts were in vain. But surely you will succeed, won't you?
map.[hota] paradise lost.header.name: Paradise Lost
map.[hota] paradise lost.sign.63.33.0.me: I keep ancient knowledge in my head, but not everyone will be able to make use of it.
map.[hota] perfect equality.header.descr: The plot is as old as the world – a dying king told four sons to find a worthy successor in a fair fight. The kingdom is great, and the king was able to give a fair piece of land to every son, so that there would be no unfair advantage.
map.[hota] perfect equality.header.name: Perfect Equality
The old man looks excited and proud of you. He grants you his knowledge.

You come to a small dwelling, built directly within an old but still quite mighty tree. In the bottom window a dim light was burning – apparently a candlestick was the only way to illuminate the house. While you were gathering your thoughts whether to come and knock on the door or not, it opened by itself and an old man stepped outside.

An old warrior lives here. He will be ready to teach you some tricks, but you must be worthy. Return when you have at least 32 attack and 14 defense.
The old man refuses to speak until you are strong enough.
You are potent enough, and the mage grants you some of his power.
You notice a small house on the outskirts of the forest. You decide to check what’s inside. You meet a mage, who is willing to grant you great power for 32 power and 14 knowledge.
You try to open the door again, but you see the 32 and 14 numbers appearing on it. You walk away.
You are approaching the house, knowing that you are ready. Inside, a man welcomes you. He offers his powers to train you in the arts of defense.

A few steps from the house, an arrow hits the ground under your legs.

"Protection - 32 points and attack - 14 points. Don’t dare to come closer without these stats."
You avoid the small house, as you know you are not yet prepared.
You come in the library, and are finally able to understand what the books are about. You learn a lot in your short time here.

You enter a small house, which appears to be a library. You randomly take a book from the shelf, but fail to understand the strange writings in it. Perhaps, possession of 32 knowledge and 14 power will grant you the knowledge of these pages.
You know that at the current time the library is a waste of time. You need more knowledge and power.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.guards.12.138: A legendary ice palace is directly above you. Centuries ago, there lived a prince who rejected the love of the Goddess of Winter, and for that she turned him and all his possessions into dead ice. Prince can be released by those who are brave enough and smart.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.guards.13.134: Once you're close to the ice palace, ice blocks, which must have pinned down the palace for centuries, began to melt...
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.guards.143.14: You want some of this? Come and get it.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.guards.40.143: Your crew is seriously thinking about mutiny.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.guards.60.114: This place drains the magical energy.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.header.descri: The treasure of the legendary pirate queen is buried on an island. Search for it!
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.header.name: Pirate's Utopia
I've heard that there are a lot of hermits on the islands that are bored without civilization.
Had you known about a beautiful legend telling the Winter's love to an unknown prince? They say that he is imprisoned far to the south at the kingdom of ancient ice.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.heroes.147.bi: Once a captive of the Goddess of Winter. Now set free by a brave hero.
What would you say, my lord?
Do you want to hire a group of evil-looking, but kind-hearted rogues?
The way to the plane of air is closed. Perhaps you may find it.
The growl and clanking of armor echoed through the cave. Nixes must have been camped nearby in the underground labyrinths.
map.[hota] province.event.0.description: These scarce lands are ravaged by war, and will not allow you to keep a large army. It is better to wait for your opponents to weaken each other, and then take a chance at delivering a final blow.
map.[hota] province.header.description: Scarce on resources, a small province was knee-deep at war between four lords. The land is barren and has no value to it, however not a single side will step back. It is a matter of principle now probably.
map.[hota] province.header.name: Province
Remember: whoever owns the sea owns all. Whoever owns the Horn of the Abyss also owns the sea. Now here's a paradox: to claim the Horn of the Abyss, you will first have to conquer the elements!
map.[hota] sails and propellers.header.d: In search of the legendary Horn of the Abyss, you will have to conquer land, sea and air. Harder still should it prove to conquer three other lords who cherish the same dream.
map.[hota] scorched earth.event.0.descri:
The once fertile land lies in ruins. Mines collapsed after an eruption on the island. Our only hope lies in the warehouses. The goods accumulated there will help to recover our strength.
The trouble, as always, does not come alone: what was not destroyed by lava, was pillaged by pirates and vultures. Besides, the lord you struggled with for years decided to strike at your weakened army, hoping to seize the entire island. Negotiation is not an option. You must prepare for the battle.
map.[hota] scorched earth.event.1.descri: Surviving workers were able to somewhat clear up the rubble. Some of the extracted resources were recovered.
map.[hota] scorched earth.event.2.descri: Remaining money was spent on paying thieves to man your distant garrison. Perhaps they will save us the hassle of unexpected guests for some time.
map.[hota] scorched earth.event.3.descri: Rumor has it that some mines in the dungeons could have survived.
map.[hota] scorched earth.guards.35.34.0:
As if it was not enough for pirates to plunder the island, they have also taken over the remains of a village.

It’s not the best idea to set a camp near the erupting volcano, but these guys seem to care little.
map.[hota] scorched earth.header.descrip: An eruption of a volcano forces you to halt extraction of resources on the island. The mines collapsed, burned down or were flooded with boiling lava. The only remaining source of supplies is the warehouses. Apparently, a neighboring lord is keeping an eye on them as well.
map.[hota] scorched earth.header.name: Scorched Earth
map.[hota] scorched earth.sign.67.27.0.m: You fished a bottle out of the water, but you found nothing more than some excellent rum inside. This one's to the pirate who lost it!
map.[hota] seven days.event.0.descriptio: The couriers report: while Ziph was fighting the barbarian hordes, our neighbor Maghera started a war against us. Her troops are already attacking our borders. Our warriors will be able to hold off her offensive for a few days, but we need to hurry back to the castle before Maghera captures it!
map.[hota] seven days.event.1.descriptio: The courier arrived with news: Maghera has managed to penetrate our border fortifications and is only a day's march away from our castle!
map.[hota] seven days.guards.33.70.0.mes: Your warriors are encouraged and eager to move!
map.[hota] seven days.guards.67.7.0.mess: Army increase on Expert and Impossible
map.[hota] seven days.guards.70.7.0.mess: More money on Expert and Impossible
map.[hota] seven days.header.description: While you were away from home, your neighbour, the scheming dark elf Maghera, decided to take your lands. You must act quickly to gather your troops, build fortifications, and return home to fight the villain!
map.[hota] seven days.header.name: Seven Days
map.[hota] seven days.heroes.200.name: Maghera
map.[hota] seven days.monster.3.51.0.mes: The warriors still loyal to you want to join your army!
map.[hota] seven days.monster.71.44.0.me: The warriors still loyal to you want to join your army!
map.[hota] strait of storms - invasion.e: You became aware that Planeswalkers did not come alone. They hired orcs, goblins, and other foreigners, so that they do all the dirty work for them.
map.[hota] strait of storms - invasion.h: Precarious peace in the strait was broken by invasion of Elemental Lords. They have created a portal in the heart of the sea. And even though you have strengthened the approaches to the monolith, the enemy did not retreat.
map.[hota] strait of storms - skirmish.h: Strait of Storms is a strategically important point on this land. Supersede a competitor from the other side and get full control over the strait!
map.[hota] strife in the woods.event.0.d: For a while, you have been a part of an alliance between knights, elves, barbarians, artificers, pirates, and swamp dwellers. Recently, some arrogant wizards arrived, and they are already making your life muserable. Their intrigues have shattered the already fragile alliance, and now they are trying to extort money from you. You are fed up with this situation and are determined to wipe out both your former allies and the racketeering wizards.
map.[hota] strife in the woods.event.1.d: The wizards came to you and demanded gold, citing an alleged obligation once taken by your ancestor to pay for the use of magic. However, as soon as your guardsmen drew their swords, the wizards retreated towards the exit. Before they left, your men took everything they had on them, including the gold they had earlier coerced out of other lords. The money went into your own coffers.
map.[hota] strife in the woods.event.2.d:
The wizards returned, but this time they came protected by golems. Seems as though they are learning from their mistakes...

You had to yield some gold to them.
map.[hota] strife in the woods.header.de: The alliance between the lords was very unstable. The knights, barbarians, and swamp dwellers were all waiting for the moment to break the treaty and benefit as much as possible from this deed. When wizards settled in the hills, the balance was disrupted, and the alliance crumbled. Prepare to war!
map.[hota] talent shortage.event.0.descr: Mullich was even madder than usual. The fleeing soldiers took everything they could carry. There was no one left in the castle. Valets, stableboys, blacksmiths, the century-old housekeeper, just about everyone legged it. The only one to stay was David the squire, whom Mullich ordered to tie to a pole the day before after the guy stole a ham from the master pantry. The kid was in for a rotten string of days, as Mullich would definitely be taking it all out on him.
map.[hota] talent shortage.guards.1.35.0: Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
Oh look, aren't these Mullich's former squad? It didn't take long for them to hit the skids without proper leadership, and it seems they're hopeful to recoup their losses out of their former commander.
Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
map.[hota] talent shortage.guards.33.5.0: A charge of lightning made Mullich's hair stand up. He feels some new knowledge boiling under his skull.
In hindsight, it was silly to hope no one would jump out of a sea of flames like this one. Well, lo and behold.
Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
map.[hota] talent shortage.guards.37.5.0: Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
This shrine is guarded after all! To arms!!!
map.[hota] talent shortage.guards.46.2.0: Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
Just as Mullich thought that was about enough Undead business for tonight...
A thief who Mullich caught feeling around his empty purse was forced to pledge himself to the knight's cause; the only other option was to be executed immediately.
map.[hota] talent shortage.guards.9.53.0: Oh, cute! These dragons are having a date here. Shame they really don't like attention.
map.[hota] talent shortage.header.descri: Sir Mullich's act got old. The morning after the infamous knight had another violent ourburst, he woke up to an empty castle. His people packed up and left in the thick of the night, just as Mullich was given a pest control mission in the royal countryhouse...
map.[hota] talent shortage.header.name: Talent Shortage
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.10.44.0: Here's your new equipment, please sign here. This also means you're to report immediately if a crusade is launched.
Come join our refitting program! We offer lighter swords, sturdier armor and nicer buc... helmets!
We won't issue armament to some random scrub. Bring an experienced swordsman.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.11.52.0: Step right up, here's your new vestment. Just try to abstain from hurling bolts indoors, will you?
Fashionable blue cassocks and powered-up bolts! For distinguished clergy only.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.12.34.0: Did you get it all? Oh great, dump it all here! You must be exhausted to carry such a pile of surplus gear.
We can take useless scrap off your hands. Well, you might call it useless, but we hope to repurpose it nicely Here's what we're after.
A helmet, a shield, a breastplate, and a sash. Would you like me to write you a list?
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.15.33.1: At last! Here, take my bow and my armor, and get that prince bastard an arrow in the belly for me if you ever happen to meet him!
I was banished into the underworld many years ago, after defeating the prince in an archery contest. I was really good, and I'd like to pass what remained of my talent onto a younger elf.
Hurry up, bring me an elf! I'm not going to last forever!
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.17.26.0: Shall we get on with the retraining?
Gee, you finally decided to give your men something more impressive than sticks and hatchets? You've come to the right place then...
Hand over the crystals, and begone. I myself am getting tired of slacking here.
Admittance will set you back 10 crystals, no less.
You don't have 10 crystals to spare? For shame! And you dare call yourself a knight!
Ready to get your hands dirty, kid?
If you want to up your shooting rate, you'll have to put in twice as much work...
I hope your elf doesn't mind partaking in my experiment. Thing is... it has a rather unusual side-effect.

I believe I've found a way to bless men who don't have innate magical abilities. I want to carry out and experiment, but I'm afraid I'm lacking a suitable subject. Do you happen to have an elf to spare? I won't break him, I promise!
An elf! I need an elf!
I heard from a wise man that a certain drawstring, severed from its bow, helps you shoot way better!
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.34.60.0: Here's our girl! Are you ready to get promoted?
Are you wondering how our tree stands unscathed in a sea of flames? Well, we're masters of the element of water, and fire can't touch us. Would you like to learn this trick? Then bring us a witch.
Only a witch can master our complicated magicks.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.35.32.1: Would you like to learn to march fast?
You can learn to march double time here.
You can learn to march double time here. Choose wisely!
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.36.28.1: Would you like to learn to shoot well?
You can learn to shoot with great accuracy here.
You can learn to shoot with great accuracy here. Choose wisely!
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.40.45.0: Oh, bless you! My collection is complete now! Would you like to pass?
I'm a collector interested in rarities crafted in the "graveyard Empire" style. I heard there are several things like that to be found in around these parts. Would you mind bringing them to me?
Skulls, bones, decay and despair. That's what I'm looking for.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.44.22.0: Hey, it's me again. I'll take 10 gems this time.
You don't have 10 gems to spare? For shame! And you dare call yourself a knight!
Here it is! Shall we trade?
A Centaur's Axe? What do you need this hunk of iron for? Hand it over, and I'll give you something nice in return.
It's an axe. Big and rather unwieldy. Get it to me.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.45.44.0: Here's a nice cassock for our new brother!
We are a militant order. Would your crusader be interested to join?
Is there no one willing to take the monastic path?
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.51.10.0: Shall we start our sword practice?
Your shooters may convert into heavy infantry here.
No shooters in your army? What kind of an army it even is?!
Did you know your rogue was an elf? We'll set him up with a bow, he'll do good with it.
We help former reprobates reform and find a righteous path in life. If you encounter one, bring him here.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.59.16.0: Hand over the ring, and I'll give your guys a nice drill.
Would you like to know the secret to be naturally sturdy? You won't even need this ring anymore, which I'm going to claim as my payment...
Ring of Vitality. It's a pretty gold trinket. Carry on with your search.
You may learn to shoot well or to march fast here, but not both.
map.[hota] terra incognita.guards.7.15.1: Undoubtedly, this tunnel should lead to the place where the town is!
map.[hota] terra incognita.header.descri: You managed to get a very old map. It marked a town filled with untold riches... Eliminate the competition and get to the treasure first!
map.[hota] terra incognita.header.name: Terra Incognita
You face the Tomb entrance. Zombies raise and launch an attack.
map.[hota] the alliance.header.descripti: An earth-shaking war between West and East is underway. You and your allies must destroy the enemy at all costs.
map.[hota] the alliance.header.name: The Alliance
map.[hota] the alliance.monster.106.58.1: Welcome to my labyrinth! It's going to take a big portion of your life!
You must defeat us before you can save the prisoner.
Have a taste of my mighty axe!
You can kiss my hairy BUTT!!
map.[hota] the alliance.quest.37.115.1.c: Wow! That's exactly what I needed. As I've said before, there are many creatures in my zoo. Among those are Faerie Dragons. They breed very well, and I can give you a few in exchange for one Crystal Dragon.
map.[hota] the alliance.quest.37.115.1.f: I'm collecting unique animals for my zoo. I've got many different creatures, but still I don't have Crystal Dragons. There is a dwelling of those north from here. Get me one, and I will reward you.
The past few years have been relatively peaceful. Occasionally, you had to fight off attacks from pirates and savages, but there was little else to worry about. However, a few days ago, alarming news started coming from the south. First, a messenger arrived, reporting odd activity of lizardmen in the swamps. Then, a whole fleet of pirates arrived from the other side of the strait. Contrary to their habit, this time the pirates weren't interested in plundering coastal villages. They seemed to be fleeing in terror from something or someone. Several sea dogs got captured, but they were so scared you couldn't coerce any information out of them. Yesterday, a traveler from the southern lands visited you. He brought frightening news: a magical cataclysm had broken out in the land of wizards in the south. Now there are icy plains interspersed with patches of surviving vegetation where swamps used to be. The wanderer doesn't know why the wizards have done this, but one thing is clear: if they are not stopped now, the cataclysm will soon devour your pirate neighbors. And then, the storm of ice will reach you.

The scouts have discovered a town of the dead deep in the caves beneath our lands, ruled by a necromancer. The undead are not aggressive (at least they haven't appeared on the surface in years), but it's good that we know about this town now. Who knows when its dwellers may come in handy!

Something intriguing has come to light. It seems that in the realm of wizards, there is a portal leading to a place where magical energy is concentrated. Perhaps this is where they draw the power they need to maintain the magical anomalies.

Our scout, sent to the pirate lands a while ago, has returned with news. Some pirate sorcerers have recently returned to their fortress. It seems that they have been studying water magic in the distant lands of the hydromancers, and they have found a way to transport their troops across water without the use of ships!
For the past few months, the wizards have been closely observing our actions. Now it seems they intend to march their forces north and strike first. The question is whether we will be ready.

map.[hota] the great wasteland.header.de: Back in the day, these lands had been bustling with life and prospering, before an experiment of a mad alchemist gone awry made them a charred wasteland. The lords who survived the calamity aim to take over this place, odd-looking but still full of treasure. You must act now to beat them to it!

Whoever can not only retrieve the treasure first, but also build the Temple of the Grail, will win this race! However, there is another way: you could simply eliminate the competitors and assert your right to these lands. What will you choose?
Scorching desert sands and gloomy tunnels of the tombs are waiting for you!
Additional funding for your expedition has arrived.
Your sponsor doesn't seem to be doing very well. Your expedition's funding was halved.

Today you received a report: the fresh financing your company received from the employer is hardly more than pocket change. You seem to be on your own now. However, this means you won't have to share the treasure with anyone either!
Things aren't easy without external funding: reluctantly, you allocate money to solve the problems that have piled up over the past week.

Treasures of the Pyramid
map.[hota] treasures of the pyramid.ques: Finally! Priceless evidence of the Pharaonic era! Give it to me, and keep the reward. I'll pay you more if you bring me another Pendant of Life.

I represent the Archaeologists' Guild. Our organization is very keen on the relics of bygone times. We are now looking for symbols of the power once wielded by the Pharaohs who built the Great Pyramid in this desert. If you happen to find the Ankh, or as it is called in these parts, the Pendant of Life, I will pay you handsomely. For each one you bring, that is!
Didn't find a single Pendant of Life? The Great Pyramid is still waiting for its explorers.

Finally! All the power of the Pharaohs, contained in this small trifle... In mine... In our hands. Do you feel the power rushing through our bodies? Bring me as many Pendants as you can find, and we will enjoy this wonderful feeling together, again and again.

The Pendants of Life... are keys. Keys to authority, power, and strength. Don't let my unsightly appearance scare you away; don't leave! Bring me a Pendant of Life so I can release the essence contained in it and share some of its hidden power with you.
